## Pull request title

Use the Conventional Commits format: `<type>(<optional scope>): <imperative summary>`.
For example: `feat(persistence): add PostgreSQL AppDbContext conventions`.
Do not use only a ticket identifier or copy the ticket title as the pull request title.

## Result

- Ticket:
- What coherent outcome does this pull request complete?
- Why is this the appropriate scope?

## Verification

- [ ] Smallest relevant automated tests passed.
- [ ] Complete build passed.
- [ ] Manual verification completed or documented as not applicable.
- Commands and outcomes:

## Documentation and architecture

- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated or no documentation change is needed.
- [ ] Architecture decisions are recorded when required or no decision is needed.
- Notes:
